children: Ladder Capital reported third-quarter 2026 interest income of $80.4 million, up 12.1% from $71.8 million a year earlier. Income attributable to Class A common shareholders rose to $65.9 million from $19.2 million, while diluted EPS increased to $0.53 from $0.15.
Interest income was $80.4M, compared with $71.8M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 12.1%.
Income attributable to Class A common shareholders was $65.9M, compared with $19.2M; YoY change 243.3%.
Diluted EPS was $0.53, compared with $0.15; YoY change 253.3%.
Mortgage loan investments increased $736.6M over the nine months, supported by $1.3B in fundings.
The securities portfolio grew $188.0M as purchases exceeded paydowns and sales; 98.9% of holdings were investment grade.
Rental income rose $14.6M year over year, reflecting acquisitions partly offset by property sales.
A property sale generated a $65.6M gain during the quarter, and another property was classified as held for sale.
Ladder Capital continued originating balance-sheet and conduit mortgages, with conduit loans available for securitization or sale.
